hero.title: Become a partner and give your animals more visibility
hero.subtitle: Are you a breeder or professional? Propose your dogs, puppies, cats or kittens and grow your visibility with our European clientele.
hero.reassurance: We support you in presenting and marketing your animals to our clientele. No sale is guaranteed.

benefits.title: Programme benefits
benefits.subtitle: Support designed for breeders and industry professionals.
benefits.visibilityDesc: Your animals presented to an active, qualified European clientele.
benefits.presentationDesc: Polished, structured listings that showcase your breeding facility.
benefits.audienceDesc: Visibility with buyers located in France and across the European area.
benefits.supportDesc: Dedicated WhatsApp follow-up to prepare your file step by step.
benefits.matchingDesc: We direct interested buyers towards your animals.
benefits.transparencyDesc: Clear steps: application, verification, validation, publication.

who.title: Who can become a partner?
who.item6: Partners with animals that comply with applicable requirements

animals.title: Which animals?
animals.subtitle: Males and females, subject to validation.

process.title: How the partnership works
process.step1Desc: You fill in the partnership form.
process.step2Desc: Our team reviews the information and documents provided.
process.step3Desc: Once the file is validated, the commercial terms and applicable deposit are communicated.
process.step4Desc: After validation and payment confirmation, the animal can be presented on the platform.
process.step5Desc: We ensure the visibility of the listing and connect you with interested people.

compliance.title: An approach based on compliance and animal welfare
compliance.intro: Our programme is built on a requirement of seriousness and responsibility.
compliance.item4: Transparency about the origin of the animals
compliance.item5: Compliance with applicable regulations and responsible transport
compliance.prohibited: Our programme in no way encourages animal trafficking, document falsification, circumvention of controls, illegal importation, the sale of sick animals or the concealment of an animal's origin.

documents.title: Documents and compliance
documents.intro: The proposed animals must be able to be accompanied by the documents required for their identification, health status and marketing, in accordance with applicable regulations.
documents.list1: Proof of identity and professional status
documents.list3: European pet record or passport for the animal
documents.note: The requested documents may vary depending on the country, species, animal's age and applicable regulations. Our team will indicate the necessary supporting documents after receiving your application.

deposit.title: How the deposit works
deposit.intro: When your file is accepted, a deposit may be requested to begin processing the file and showcasing the animal.
deposit.factorsTitle: The deposit amount may vary depending on:
deposit.factor2: the species and type of animal
deposit.disclaimer: The exact deposit amount will be communicated to you after your application has been reviewed and before any final validation of the partnership. No amount is due at the time of application.

warning.title: Important notice
warning.body: The validation of a partnership and the marketing of an animal are subject to the verification of the information and documents provided as well as compliance with applicable regulations. Requirements may vary depending on the country, species and situation of the animal. Acceptance as a partner is not a guarantee of sale.

form.title: Application form
form.subtitle: 6 quick steps. Your information is stored only in your browser until you submit.
form.experience: How long have you been in the profession?
form.country: Country of residence / breeding facility location
form.animalsDesc: Select the categories you wish to propose. You will be able to detail each animal with our team via WhatsApp.
form.animalNotesPlaceholder: Approximate age, availability, particularities, desired price…
form.hasVideos: I have videos of the animals
form.hasParentPhotos: I have photos of the parents
form.hasPedigree: I have pedigree documents (LOF, LOOF or equivalent)
form.hasVetDocs: I have veterinary and health certificates
form.uploadNote: After sending your application, our team will indicate via WhatsApp how to transmit the necessary photos, videos and documents. No document is transmitted from this form.
form.acceptData: I accept that the information provided will be used to review my application for the partnership programme and to contact me about it.
form.acceptTruth: I certify that the information provided is accurate and that my animals comply with applicable regulations.
form.termsRequired: Please accept the required conditions to continue.
form.animalsRequired: Please select at least one animal category.
form.whatsappBody: When you confirm, a pre-filled message opens in WhatsApp with your application details. WhatsApp then becomes the main channel to send your documents and communicate with the team.
form.whatsappIntro: Hello, I would like to become a partner and propose one or more animals for sale.
form.whatsappOutro: I wish to send the documents and information required to review my application.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Breeders and professionals meeting the criteria of our programme can submit an application.
faq.a2: Dogs, puppies, cats and kittens, males and females, subject to validation.
faq.q3: Do I need to provide documents?
faq.a3: Yes. The requested documents make it possible to verify the identification, origin and health status of the animal.
faq.q4: How much does the partnership cost?
faq.a4: The terms and the deposit may vary depending on the country and the file. The applicable amount is communicated before validation.
faq.a5: Yes, the form lets you indicate several categories and several animals.
faq.q6: How do I send my documents?
faq.a6: After the application, our team supports you via WhatsApp for the transmission of the necessary documents and information.
faq.q7: Does registration guarantee the sale of my animal?
faq.a7: No. Acceptance as a partner is not a guarantee of sale.
faq.q8: In which countries can I propose my animals?
faq.a8: The programme is mainly intended for partners located in France and in the various European countries, subject to compliance with applicable regulations.
